title: 第699章 艾可修行大有长进第698章 漫步
slug: 性转狐狸开局就被抓走了
content_zh:
艾可在一棵棵树间纵跃，脚下树干尽数吱呀摇晃，完全达不到黛露那般行云流水的境界。
“我肯定哪里做错了……”艾可心中苦恼，两种步法都难以融会贯通，更别说同时催动三门术法。
根源在于每一套功法催动妖核灵力的运转方式截然不同。
艾可倒是想到可以分别依靠多枚妖核承载不同术法，可难题远不止于此。三套功法需要同步维持三种截然不同的灵力操控节奏，这才是困住她的最大难关。
哪怕她动用
时间凝滞之术放慢周遭万物，也依旧没办法同时稳住三套功法的运转。
终究是修行阅历太过浅薄。
“一步一步来吧……”艾可长叹一口气。堆积在身上的修行课业越来越多，往后只会愈发繁重。
“当初真是给自己揽了超出能力的活，可事到如今，只能硬着头皮练，练到融会贯通为止。”艾可连连点头给自己打气。
她打算先将轻身术与疾风步磨合顺畅，做到同步施展互不冲突。
这套组合不算太难，轻身术几乎是所有身法的根基，只是各类步法催动时调用的灵力强度各有区别。
对轻身术的掌握深浅，直接决定了其余身法的上限。
第一步，依靠轻身术进入失重漂浮状态；第二步衔接疾风步，借风力牵引身形前行。
气流会先缠绕双腿，继而包裹全身，化作肉眼不可见的微型旋风环绕周身。
以此大幅削弱高速移动产生的空气阻力，让自身速度突破原本的极限。
接下来还要融入幻影步，麻烦也全出在这里。
和疾风步不同，幻影步对轻身术的依赖极低，更多依靠身形摇曳幻化出重重残影。
她从前倒是能交替切换两套步法勉强糊弄过去，但这并非黛露布置功课的初衷。
若想登峰造极，做到连修行高手都分辨不出虚实的幻身，只能沉下心苦修磨合。
幻影步是三者里最难驾驭的，艾可索性暂时搁置另外两套功法，专心打磨幻影步，修行进度总算快了不少。

“这种触感，像踏在水面上一般……”
艾可忆起从前踏上灵湖、前往悟道古树时的感受。那片湖面无法潜入水下，行走其上便如同踩在水面悬空而立。
幻影步带来的体感与之如出一辙，艾可暗自猜想，这套步法的创造者便是以此湖面意境为根基所创。
而这，正是三套功法无法共存的核心症结。
疾风步依托风元素运转，幻影步则融合水、温热两种灵力。
幻影步需要精细调和的水与温热灵力，会立刻被疾风步裹挟的气流吹散，整套身法的平衡瞬间崩塌。
原本最直接的解决办法，是寻一门能兼容水、风、温热三系灵力的功法作为调和媒介，但这法子显然行不通。
以黛露这位宗主长老的性子，若是投机取巧另借外力完成课业，只会加重惩罚，功课难度翻倍。
照眼下这磨合进度，她搞不好真要挨罚了——
“会不会是我疾风步造诣过高，两种功法层次失衡，才难以共存？”
艾可停下脚步思索，她打算先把幻影步的熟练度提升，再重新尝试三法同催。
……
content_en:
Ai Ke jumped from tree to tree, and the tree trunks creaked and swayed under his feet, completely unable to reach the state of flowing clouds and flowing water like Delu.
"I must have done something wrong..." Ai Ke was troubled in his heart. It was difficult to master the two steps, let alone activate three techniques at the same time.
The root cause is that each set of exercises has a completely different way of stimulating the spiritual power of the demon core.
Ai Ke thought that he could rely on multiple demon cores to carry different spells, but the problem went beyond that. The three sets of exercises need to be synchronized to maintain three completely different rhythms of spiritual power control. This is the biggest difficulty that traps her.
Even if she uses
The art of time stasis slows down everything around him, and it is still impossible to stabilize the operation of the three sets of exercises at the same time.
After all, my spiritual practice experience is too shallow.
"Let's do it step by step..." Ai Ke sighed. More and more practice lessons are piling up on me, and they will only become more burdensome in the future.
"At first I was given a job that was beyond my ability, but now, I can only practice hard until I master it." Ai Ke nodded repeatedly to encourage himself.
She planned to smoothen the Light Body Technique and the Wind Step first so that they could be used simultaneously without conflicting with each other.
This combination is not too difficult. Light body technique is almost the foundation of all movement techniques, but the intensity of the spiritual power called upon by each type of footwork is different.
The mastery of light body techniques directly determines the upper limit of other body techniques.
The first step is to rely on the light body technique to enter a weightless floating state; the second step is to connect with the wind step and use the wind to pull the body forward.
The airflow will first wrap around the legs, and then wrap around the whole body, turning into a micro-whirlwind invisible to the naked eye and surrounding the whole body.
This greatly weakens the air resistance generated by high-speed movement, allowing its own speed to exceed its original limit.
Next, we have to integrate the Phantom Step, and this is where all the trouble comes from.
Unlike the Wind Step, the Phantom Step relies very little on the Light Body Technique, and relies more on the swaying of the body to create numerous afterimages.
In the past, she could barely get by by switching between two sets of footwork, but this was not the original intention of Delu's assignment.
If you want to reach the pinnacle, so that even master practitioners can't tell the difference between the real and the real illusory body, you can only practice hard and practice hard.
Phantom Step was the most difficult to control among the three. Ai Ke simply put aside the other two sets of exercises for the time being and concentrated on polishing Phantom Step. The progress of his practice finally improved a lot.
"This feeling is like walking on water..."
Ai Ke recalled the feeling he had when he set foot on the Spirit Lake and went to the Ancient Tree of Enlightenment. There is no way to dive into that lake, and walking on it is like standing on the water while standing in the air.
The physical sensation brought by the phantom step is exactly the same. Ai Ke secretly guessed that the creator of this set of steps was based on the artistic conception of the lake.
And this is the core reason why the three sets of exercises cannot coexist.
The Wind Step relies on the wind element to operate, while the Phantom Step combines the two spiritual powers of water and warmth.
The phantom step requires finely blended water and warm spiritual power, which will be immediately blown away by the airflow encircled by the wind step, and the balance of the entire body technique will instantly collapse.
Originally, the most direct solution was to find a technique that was compatible with the three spiritual powers of water, wind, and warmth as a mediating medium, but this method obviously didn't work.
With the temperament of Dai Lu, the sect leader and elder, if she resorted to opportunism and relied on outside resources to complete her homework, the punishment would only be aggravated and the homework would be twice as difficult.
According to the current progress of running-in, she might really be punished——
"Could it be that my attainments in the Wind Step are too high and the levels of the two techniques are out of balance, making it difficult to coexist?"
Ai Ke stopped and thought. She planned to improve her proficiency in Phantom Step first, and then try the three techniques again.
